text: This article is a narrative review rather than a formal systematic review or meta-analysis. Our aim was to provide a clinically oriented synthesis of recent mechanistic, neurophysiological, and clinical evidence on taVNS for disorders of consciousness. The literature search was updated close to the date of revision, and the body of evidence considered spans studies published from 2017 to 2026.
source_label: Transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation for disorders of consciousness: a narrative review of neurophysiological mechanisms, clinical evidence, and future directions
